svg.title: Attribute the full workload cost
svg.desc: The same checkout flow shows cost-bearing edge requests, compute including tested recovery headroom, order-data retention, and deferred work. Attribute the full workload cost, not only the application host.

text.tspan: One cost model. One accountable owner.
